mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces risk-free rates, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 9.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0), manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and lower earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS above 380,000 million) indicates strong aggregate demand, supporting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 380,000 million, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL above 225.0) signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE above 9.0%) and declines in employment (PAYEMS below 131,000 thousand) indicate a severe labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0% and PAYEMS < 131000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 93.0) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 93.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
